We need to determine SMILES of unknown compound given only description? The prompt says "Analyze the provided organic compound sample in a lab environment". But we have no data provided. Likely we need to use tools to get spectra etc. But we have no initial data. Perhaps the environment already has a sample "at hand". The tools like mass_spectrometry_spectra, proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra will give data for the sample. We need to infer structure.

We should start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra.
